description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small stack of colorful chunky blocks—blue, red, green, yellow, and white—near the middle of the blanket. The right hand reaches in from the right to pick up the stacked blocks and jiggles them so a red piece drops off, then both hands come together to pull pieces apart: the left hand briefly holds a green and then a yellow block while the right hand keeps a blue-and-red section, and finally the right hand separates off the remaining red and sets the blue down as the loose blocks end up spread out on the bed.
